name: memorylayer-codex-plugin
description: MemoryLayer integration for Codex via MCP and persistent project-memory guidance.

interface.shortDescription: Persistent MemoryLayer memory and recall for Codex.
interface.longDescription: Connects Codex to MemoryLayer through the MemoryLayer MCP server and adds guidance for recall, durable memory capture, sessions, and context-environment workflows.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use MemoryLayer when prior project decisions, preferences, or durable agent memory would improve the Codex task.
